autoD: The app syncs your banks and cards by itself, even when it is closed. Opening the app never starts a sync.
howD: For every connected bank and card.
h0: Never, only when I press Sync now
timeD: Your accounts sync at this time every day.
offD: Banks and cards only sync when you press Sync now.
routineT: How far back each sync reads
routineD: A short period is quick and gentle on the bank.
firstImpT: How far back a new bank or card reads
firstImpD: Used once, when you add a bank or card. The app keeps whatever the bank still has (usually 1 to 2 years). To read further back later, open its card in Settings → Connections, pick 1 year, 2 years or 5 years in the list next to Sync now, then press Sync now.
f1825: Up to 5 years (whatever the bank has)
logD: Each time a bank or card was read: what was asked for and what came back.
loadFail: The sync log could not be loaded.
